body: Seems like a simple fix, and also surprised at `$HOME` isn't set but the Test Encyclopedia spec defines that it is.
I'll take a stab with a test too.
It turns out `LOGNAME` is also unset, and `SHLVL` is 1.

issue.title: Ensure correct environment variables in test environment

repository.name: bazel
repository.description: a fast, scalable, multi-language and extensible build system

issue.body:
This PR adds a simple C++ test (`tools/test/testsetup_test`) to verify test environment matches as defined in the [Test Encyclopedia](https://docs.bazel.build/versions/master/test-encyclopedia.html#initial-conditions).  This test identified 3 problems:
  - `HOME` is unset (#10652)
  - `LOGNAME` is unset
  - `SHLVL` is not `2`

The PR fixes `tools/test/test-setup.sh` such that:
  - explicitly export `HOME` when changed (reported in #10652)
  - update `LOGNAME` to `USER` when unset
  - `SHLVL` is always set to `2`

Fixes #10652

issue.body:
This is mandated by the test encyclopedia, but HOME wasn't exported and isn't set by the test action.

Fixes #10652
Fixes https://github.com/bazel-contrib/rules_go/issues/4108

RELNOTES: Tests now have `HOME` set to a temporary directory. Set `--test_env==HOME` to unset it.
